needs_human.note: When the first write's body equals the current text, the code skips recording the new version and reports 'unchanged' for both auto and explicit kinds. The spec says the existing dedup rule decides; the code instead bypasses that rule for auto saves.; The Markdown tag write's first write produces an explicit baseline with no viewer followed by an auto row with no viewer. The auto row can later be evicted by the cap or collapsed.

The baseline and the new version are recorded in the same nested transaction. If recording the new version fails, the baseline rolls back with it. The write still succeeds, which satisfies I3, but the baseline is lost and is only taken on the next write.; If the first write's body equals the file's current text, the code records only the baseline and reports 'unchanged', even for an auto save, where it used to report 'created'.
